SMLC.description: Settlement Load Case (SMLC). A settlement load case bundles a scale factor, a min/max range of active settlement groups, and the list of settlement groups (ST_GROUPS) that participate; each group name is resolved to an existing settlement point group at assign time.

FACTOR.description: Settlement scale factor applied to the load case.

MIN.description: Minimum number of settlement groups assumed to settle simultaneously.

MAX.description: Maximum number of settlement groups assumed to settle simultaneously.

ST_GROUPS.description: Names of the settlement (point) groups included in this load case. Each name must resolve to an existing settlement group; unknown names are skipped with a warning at assign time.
